redesigned.note: First redesign since 1991, announced by City & County of Honolulu Aug 20, 2026: larger full-color medal, 'Combat Wounded' vertical at left.

notes: No new specialty plate found: the only full special-design plates remain Haleakala, Hawaii Volcanoes and Polynesian Voyaging Society; other groups use small decals on special-number plates (SB1095 2025 would enlarge decals to 4x4 in). The 2024 law (Act 64) re-spelled the base plate 'Hawai'i' from Jan 2025 and limited the never-issued environmental-conservation plate to EVs; the EV plate seen on roads is a required designation (5-character format from 2025), not a specialty plate. Honolulu's Veteran plate image is dated 2025 but no redesign is confirmed. Hawaii County's specialty-plate page failed to load and the Honolulu special-plate order site blocks robots, so no gallery (robot_url) was found.
